أتكوسج (form IIq)
# أَتَكَوْسَجُ (ʔatakawsaju) /ʔa.ta.kaw.sa.d͡ʒu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَكَوْسَجَ (takawsaja)
# أَتَكَوْسَجَ (ʔatakawsaja) /ʔa.ta.kaw.sa.d͡ʒa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَكَوْسَجَ (takawsaja)
# أَتَكَوْسَجْ (ʔatakawsaj) /ʔa.ta.kaw.sad͡ʒ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَكَوْسَجَ (takawsaja)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
